scheme_name: Coaching Assistance Scheme for Preparation of Recruitment Exams for Scheduled Caste Students
other_conditions: The student must have passed graduation with at least 50% marks.
The applicant or the applicant's parents should not be in government employment.
The applicant cannot pursue full‑time studies, job, or business elsewhere during the training period.
The benefit is available only once to the applicant.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹20,000 or the actual fee, whichever is lower, directly credited to the student’s bank account via DBT.
